name: 陆野
source: 《八零新婚夜，空间囤货养崽暴富》男主

identity.en: A tall broad-shouldered twenty-five-year-old Chinese peasant man, early 1980s rural northern China
identity.text: 25 岁北方农村壮劳力，1980 年代初

face.en: Square strong jaw, thick dark straight brows like blade strokes, narrow phoenix eyes with deep black pupils, a two-centimeter old scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, weathered tan skin, tight-lipped resolute expression
face.text: 国字脸硬朗，浓黑粗眉像刀，狭长丹凤眼深黑瞳，左眉尾两厘米旧疤，黝黑皮肤，唇紧抿

hair.en: Short black buzz-cut, hairline slightly rough, no styling
hair.text: 黑色短寸平头，发际线略粗，无造型

top.en: A faded washed-out army green cotton padded jacket, front-buttoned, cuffs worn and frayed, shoulders broad, sleeves tight on muscular arms
top.text: 洗发白的军绿色粗布对襟棉袄，袖口磨旧，肩宽背厚袖子绷在结实手臂上

bottom.en: Dark grey coarse cotton padded trousers, work-worn, thick-soled black cloth shoes caked with mud
bottom.text: 深灰色粗布棉裤，干活磨旧，沾泥的黑布千层底鞋

details.en: The short black buzz-cut hairline and strong jaw
details.text: 黑色短寸发际线与硬朗下颌

details.en: The frayed army green collar and rough cloth knot button
details.text: 磨旧的军绿立领与盘扣

details.en: The thick calloused hand emerging from the frayed army green cuff
details.text: 从军绿磨旧袖口伸出的厚茧大手

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
